item.title: About this blog
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
This blog shows interesting artifacts that I have acquired on my visits to flea markets, in antique shops and online in and around Göttingen. The objects shown are only a selection; media such as books, magazines, postcards, posters, records, tapes, video games and films as well as everyday objects are usually not filed.

For each object some additional information is offered, among other things the price at which it was acquired — this does not mean that the object in question is for sale — as well as the location. Where no information is stored, there is currently still placeholder text (Lorem Ipsum ).

item.title: Privacy policy
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Privacy policy

Hosting

The hoster collects the following data transmitted by your browser in log files:

  • IP address
  • The address of the previously visited website (Referer [sic!] request header)
  • Date and time of the enquiry
  • Time zone difference to Greenwich Mean Time
  • Content of the request
  • HTTP status code
  • Amount of data transferred
  • Website from which the request originates
  • Information about the browser and operating system

This is necessary to display the website and to ensure stability and security. This corresponds to a legitimate interest within the meaning of Art. 6 para. 1 sentence 1 lit. f GDPR .
